_meta.note: Real question set, ported from the interview-capture sheet (RIV_Index_Interview_Capture_Q3_2026). Only 'scored' questions with an indexDimension contribute to the composite Index score — see lib/indexScoring.js. Everything else (profile, open, single_select, multi_select, yesno, consent) is still collected and stored, just not averaged.

_indexDimensionsNote: These 5 match the RIV Retail AI Maturity Model exactly (see the Executive Conversation deck). IMPORTANT GAP: the interview-capture sheet as supplied has no 'Scored' (1-5) item under Section D (Retail AI Use Cases) — D02/D09 are open-ended only. Until a scored D-section item is added, 'Retail AI Use Cases' will show as null in every dimension breakdown and the overall Index score is computed from the 4 dimensions that do have data. Flagged for follow-up rather than guessed at.

questions.text: Name of Organisation
Respondent Name
Designation
Primary Role in AI / Innovation
Organisation Type
Primary Geography
Approximate Organisation Scale
questions.hint: e.g. revenue, number of stores, employee count — whatever's most meaningful for your organisation.

questions.text: Does leadership actively use AI in their own daily work, not just sponsor it for others?
Does the organisation have a clearly accountable executive owner for AI?
What is the biggest thing leadership currently gets wrong or underestimates about AI?
Which best describes your organisation's current AI maturity?
questions.note: Self-reported maturity stage — kept separate from the computed Index score (which is derived from the dimension-scored questions), shown alongside it for comparison rather than averaged in.

questions.text: What is the biggest barrier preventing AI pilots from moving into production?
Which 3 AI use cases currently create the greatest business value?
questions.hint: Ask for measurable outcomes if possible.

questions.text: If you could redesign one major retail workflow from scratch using AI, which would you choose?
questions.probe: This is a key qualitative question.

questions.text: How ready is your data environment to support enterprise AI?
How often does AI adoption result in a redesign of roles or workflows?
Has the organisation experimented with AI agents executing multi-step workflows?
Which workflows would you be most comfortable allowing an AI agent to execute today?
If you could give one AI agent a meaningful job tomorrow, what would that job be?
Would a curated, retail-specific pipeline of validated AI startups be valuable to your organisation?
questions.note: Opportunity signal for RIV, not one of the 5 core Index dimensions — excluded from the composite score.

questions.text: What is the single most important metric you would use to judge whether your AI strategy is working?
What is your organisation currently doing exceptionally well in AI?
If you could change one thing about how your organisation approaches AI over the next 12 months, what would it be?
Would an independent assessment of your organisation's AI & innovation readiness be useful?
questions.note: Opportunity signal for RIV, not one of the 5 core Index dimensions — excluded from the composite score.

questions.text: Would you be interested in receiving your organisation's private benchmark against the Index cohort?
Would you be interested in a follow-up discussion on your organisation's AI & Innovation priorities?
Can RIV use anonymised responses in the Index?
Can RIV identify your organisation as a participating organisation?
Can RIV attribute direct quotations to you / your organisation?
Would you be interested in joining the RIV Retail AI Research Council / Executive Roundtable?
